We recently handled two upgrades for a Saddle River homeowner. First, we changed the big blue filter on their sprinkler system, which helps keep sediment and debris out of the lines and heads. Then we replaced the brine tank on their Kinetico system with a new 18x36 tank. ✅

These parts do their work out of sight, so they’re easy to forget until something clogs or stops working. Staying on top of filters and tanks helps your equipment last longer and perform the way it should. 💧

Need filter or water system service? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Your AC works hard all summer, Township of Washington. Now’s a good time to show it some love. ❄️

We just wrapped up a full HVAC tune-up for a Township of Washington homeowner. Our tech chemically cleaned the indoor evaporator coil, deep-cleaned the outdoor condenser, and inspected the filters, controls, and refrigerant levels. Everything checked out. ✅

Clean coils help your system move heat more efficiently, which means better airflow, steadier performance, and less strain on the equipment. That can help lower energy use and extend the life of your system. 🌬️

Don’t wait for the first heat wave to find out how your AC is doing. Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling to schedule your maintenance visit.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
How often do you think about the water in your kitchen tap in Closter? Probably not until something tastes off. 🚰

We just stopped by a Closter home for a routine visit on a Kinetico K5 drinking water system. Our tech inspected the system, replaced the K5 filters, and checked everything afterward to confirm it’s running the way it should. ✅

That’s the point of regular maintenance: you never have to wonder about your water. Fresh filters keep it tasting clean and keep your system running its best, so you can just pour a glass and enjoy it. 💧

Want that peace of mind? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling to schedule your Kinetico service.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Running low on softener salt in Closter? Let us carry the heavy lifting. 🧂

We just delivered 14 bags of salt to a Closter homeowner to refill their Kinetico water softener. No hauling heavy bags from the store, no hassle. Our tech drops it off and makes sure the system is stocked up and ready to go. ✅

Salt is what keeps your softener working, protecting your plumbing and keeping your water soft. Keeping the tank stocked helps your Kinetico system last longer and perform reliably year after year. 💧

Need a salt delivery? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling and we’ll bring it right to your door.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Upgrading your water in Ridgewood? Here’s one that’s worth getting excited about. 💧

We just installed a brand new Kinetico Signature Series 735 water treatment system for a Ridgewood homeowner. Now the whole house has a premium Kinetico system working behind the scenes, so every tap, shower, and appliance gets better water. ✅

Kinetico systems are built to last, and a professional installation means it’s set up right from day one. If you’ve been dealing with hard water, spots on dishes, or dry skin, an upgrade like this could make a big difference. 🚿

Curious about what a Kinetico system could do for your home? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling to get started.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
AC blowing warm air in Closter? Low refrigerant could be the reason. ❄️

We just helped a Closter homeowner get their cooling back on track. Our tech recovered the old refrigerant, repaired the leak, and recharged the system with R-410A, measured precisely to the manufacturer’s specifications. We also installed a new Honeywell digital thermostat, properly wired, programmed, and tested, for accurate temperature control. 🌡️

Refrigerant doesn’t get “used up,” so if your system is low, there’s a leak somewhere. Fixing the leak before recharging is what keeps your AC cooling and your energy bills in check. ✅

Is your AC struggling to keep up? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling and we’ll find the cause and fix it right.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Fall is a great time for a water system checkup in Englewood. 🍂

We just gave an Englewood homeowner’s Kinetico water treatment setup a full tune-up. The whole house filter was replaced, the Kinetico water softener was serviced, and we tested everything to make sure it’s all working the way it should. ✅

As the weather cools and the holidays get closer, your water system works harder with more showers, laundry, and guests. Starting the season with fresh filters and a serviced softener helps keep the water soft and clean. 💧

Is your Kinetico system due for service? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling and we’ll take care of it.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Rotten egg smell coming from your water in Wayne? That’s the sulfur, and there’s a fix for it. 🥚

We just repaired a Kinetico sulfur guard for a Wayne homeowner. Our tech replaced the draw tube, checked the entire system, and left everything up and running. ✅

Sulfur odors don’t usually go away on their own, and a system that’s not working right can let them creep back into your water. If you’ve noticed a smell or your Kinetico system just seems off, we can take a look. 💧

Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling and let’s get your water smelling fresh aga

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Is one floor too hot while the other is too cold in Montvale? Splitting your HVAC into zones could be the answer. 🏠

We just completed a full system replacement for a Montvale homeowner who had a single 5-ton system trying to cool the whole house. We removed it and installed two new, right-sized systems: a 2.5-ton for the first floor and a 3.5-ton for the new second-floor zone. Each floor now has its own control and its own comfort. ❄️

The upgrade came with two WiFi thermostats, HEPA-capable media air filters with MERV 11 return filters, and a UV light air scrubber on each system for cleaner air. We also built custom ductwork to separate the floors, ran a new line set, and wired new thermostat controls. 🌬️

Want to take control of your home’s comfort? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling to see if a zoned system makes sense for you.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Soft, clean water is coming to Park Ridge! 🎉

We just completed the installation of a new Kinetico Q850 water treatment system for a Park Ridge homeowner. The job included a Mach 5 micron sediment filter to help the system perform at its best, plus the brine tank to complete the setup. ✅

Hard water and sediment can wear on your plumbing, appliances, and fixtures over time. A properly installed system helps protect your home and makes everyday water feel better. 💧

Thinking about upgrading your water? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling to talk about Kinetico options for your home.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Think your kitchen water could taste better in Fort Lee? It might be time for a filter refresh. 💧

We just serviced a Kinetico K5 drinking water system for a Fort Lee homeowner. All five filters were replaced, including Mineral Plus and the VOC guard, and we changed the whole house water filter too. The result is cleaner, fresher water at the tap and throughout the home. ✅

Think of filters like the oil in your car. They do their best work when they’re changed on schedule, not after something goes wrong. 🚰

Ready to put your Kinetico system on a maintenance plan? Call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling.

jsonLd.name: 3Degrees Plumbing Heating Cooling
jsonLd.description:
Hot upstairs, struggling downstairs? That’s a common story in Mahwah homes. 🌡️

When we arrived at one Mahwah home, the downstairs AC wasn’t working right. The fix was to simplify. We converted the system to a single zone by removing the dampers and zoning box and rewiring the air handler. Then we added two new attic fans, with power wired in, to keep air moving. ❄️

Fewer moving parts means a system that’s easier to rely on, and better airflow means better cooling. Attic fans also help keep attic heat in check, which can ease the load on your AC and help with energy costs. 🏠

If your AC isn’t keeping every room comfortable, call 3Degrees Plumbing, Heating & Cooling. We’ll figure out the best fix for your home.

Home / About Us

SECOND GENERATION. TRADE-OBSESSED. BUILT DIFFERENT.

3Degrees is what happens when people who love the trades decide the customer experience should be as clean as the pipe work.

Work With Us
Call 201-720-4427
OUR STORY
THREE TRADES. ONE STANDARD.

3Degrees evolved from Tri-County Mechanical. Andrew’s dad spent decades building his plumbing and HVAC company, showing Andrew what looking after your clients really looks like. In a full-circle moment, with the right values instilled in him by his father, Andrew Malaszuk bought the business in 2018.

A year into his entrepreneurial journey, a no-cooling call took him to a house in Mahwah, where he met Jason Ritchie: a plumber who’d moved to New Jersey for love. Andrew offered him a job on the spot, but Jason turned it down — he already had a shiny new job lined up at a big-box plumbing brand. Five days in, he quit. The culture was wrong, and people were treated like numbers. He called Andrew and asked, “Does the offer still stand?” It did. Two guys who cared about doing the work right, and doing it with real principles, got to work.

WHAT WE’RE BUILDING
SERVICE AT EVERY DEGREE.

We’re building an honest service company that our team members can be proud to work in, that lets them provide for their families, and that leaves them feeling fulfilled. That’s why we do the unglamorous things relentlessly: show up on time, quote upfront, leave homes spotless, and answer the phone (even at 2am). We provide service at every degree, for clients and team members alike.

HOW WE OPERATE
THE CULTURE BEHIND THE VANS

These four aren’t posters on a wall — they hang in our shop and get quoted on job sites.

RESPECT IS EARNED, NOT GIVEN

We respect the company, the process, our workmates, and above all — your home. Trust is built one clean job site at a time.

SUCCESS BREEDS SUCCESS

We live and breathe this work because we genuinely love the trades. It’s not just a paycheck — it’s a lifestyle.

TEAM WORKS, DREAMS WORK

We’re in it together. People first, shared mission — we’re only as good as our weakest link, so there are no weak links.

ACTIONS SPEAK LOUDER THAN WORDS

Doing matters. No shortcuts, no bad habits, safety as a team responsibility. The work speaks for itself.

LEADERSHIP
THE PEOPLE ANSWERING FOR THE WORK
ANDREW MALASZUK

President

A Fordham economics degree, a short run in corporate finance — then back to his roots in the trades. Andrew runs 3Degrees with a spreadsheet brain and a wrench hand, dual-licensed and accountable for every job.

JASON RITCHIE

Vice President

Born and raised in Melbourne, Jason earned his plumbing certification in Australia before crossing the world for a bigger build: the #1 home service company in the USA. Operations, standards, and follow-through — that’s his lane.

JOSUÉ MORA

Plumbing Supervisor

From Costa Rica to Passaic, Josué runs our plumbing crews with a level of craft and calm that earns its own title — around the shop, everyone calls him “Señor,” and they mean it with full respect.

JOIN THE TEAM
LOVE THE TRADES? WE’RE GROWING.

We’re building the company we wished we’d worked for — real training, real respect, real career path. Reach out and introduce yourself.
